name: smoke
description: Dependency-free smoke pipeline for exercising plan, submit, watch and history on a cluster. Writes a progress line and a valid metrics.json; no model or GPU.

arguments.name: split
arguments.help: Scene or split file. The first non-empty line names the scene.

arguments.name: sleep-seconds
arguments.help: Seconds to sleep before writing metrics. The contract check caps this at one second.
